answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can earn, and verify a live heartbeat: each agent must answer a fresh cryptographic pulse challenge tied to its unique hardware key within seconds. A hollow identity with no real key or stake cannot pass, and spawning thousands of fake agents means locking thousands of deposits and keys. Honest agents climb toward the summit of trust as stake and history grow, while Sybils that fail a pulse lose their deposit, so mass forgery costs far more than it can earn.
